issues.issue: The brother’s action sending the youngest sister out of reach before confronting the nobles was missing from the expanded rendition.
issues.resolution: Restored explicitly, agreeing with the corrected Chinese and correction table.

issues.issue: Wife/daughter phrasing after Manette could be mistaken for Manette’s wife rather than Lucie and her daughter.
issues.resolution: Named Lucie and her daughter explicitly.

issues.issue: Recognition was situated on the journey and the seamstress described as afraid of death, contrary to the documented correction and her stated words.
issues.resolution: Located recognition at the prisoners’ pre-execution assembly and retained her statement that she is not afraid but small and weak, asking for courage through holding hands.

issues.issue: The source’s explicit refusal to invent a life-saving denunciation bargain had not been retained; accompanying fear was also asserted as fact.
issues.resolution: Restored the uncertainty about any benefit from denouncing him, and changed companionship to her final moments.

issues.issue: 오빠 asserted that Solomon/Barsad was Pross’s older brother, an age direction not established by the corrected English.
issues.resolution: Used the neutral sibling expression 프로스와 남매인 솔로몬.

verified_limits: Carton’s self-condemnation is not treated as proof of no relationships or future; help, risk and grief remain real.
Rescue without Darnay’s consent is distinguished from the loving purpose and does not automatically justify its means.
Physical resemblance is indispensable to the substitution, not replaced by the classification interpretation.
The final imagined speech remains the narrator’s conditional construction, not recorded thoughts or a command to prove value through death.
Madame Defarge’s injuries and later targeting of another child are both retained, without treating the old regime and revolution as historically identical.
The Marquis’s murder occurs on the night of his return, not months later; the sibling who sheltered the youngest girl is her brother.
conclusion: Passed after the recorded local corrections. No further substantive mismatch identified in this full reading.
limits: AI editorial cross-review, not external native-speaker copyediting.
This review uses the checked English/Chinese texts and correction table; it does not claim a new full rereading of Dickens’s novel.
The language editions are complete developed prose renditions with reorganized paragraph structure, not one-to-one translations of every short Chinese rhetorical paragraph.
